testing_evidence.evidence: Exact destination and old-path assertions cover both crates, every new file is Git-visible, the ignored common-wire blob retains its pre-move hash, inline bodies leave src, and release checks prove cfg(test) isolation.
Exact Cargo list comparisons require the pre-move 18 p2p-frame names and one sn-miner name, while unit, DV, and integration steps execute every moved or already-correct 020-owned test surface.

testing_case_type_coverage.gap_manual_reason: The static step checks the root ignore collision, exact source/destination allowlist, nested-unit discovery boundary, and inline extraction boundary.
The static step fails if any old source file, ignored new file, inline test body, or accidental tests/unit integration target remains.
The move introduces no production error category or recovery flow; bad include paths and missing files fail compilation or the static step.
Both crate release checks compile with test-only includes disabled and no public seam.
Physical test-source placement owns no runtime lifecycle; existing lifecycle tests are executed under registration parity.
One static allowlist validates p2p-frame and sn-miner destinations together while each crate compiles its private loader.
Exact selected name sets must equal 18 and 1 with no missing or extra module names before filtered commands run.
The list-comparison steps fail on renamed, missing, duplicated, or unexpected matching tests and therefore reject a zero-test filter path.
Registration parity adds no production error behavior; command or assertion failures are test infrastructure failures surfaced by nonzero exit status.
Original module filters plus the external public API and SN profile-flow tests run unchanged.
The real UDP probe and NAT-aware TunnelManager modules retain probe, owner-cancellation, prediction, direction, and fallback execution.
The already-correct public consumer, SN query/call flow, and extracted distributed query case exercise neighboring boundaries.
